name: CoreLoggingWorkbench
tagline: Diamond core logging from core shed to validated data – strip log, fast interval logging, recovery, RQD and QAQC in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete plug-and-play core logging module for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages. Track every interval through Received, Marked up, Photographed, Logged, Sampled and Validated with enforced rules, log lithology, weathering, alteration, mineralisation and RQD inline, see a downhole strip log per hole, catch overlaps, gaps and duplicate sample IDs, generate sample IDs and prove the QAQC insertion rate.
features: Six-step core shed workflow with business rules and undo
Downhole graphic strip log with lithology colours, recovery and RQD bars
Keyboard-driven inline logging workbench with next interval and split
Recovery % and RQD % per interval and per hole
Overlap, gap, duplicate sample ID and sample length checks
Generate sample IDs and insert standards, blanks and duplicates
Bulk actions, CSV export, filters, grouping
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
controlType: standard (2 controls: CoreLoggingWorkbench data-set + CoreLoggingWorkbenchPortal field control)
